messages:
Ana - AE: Hey team — FinSys (large EU financial) wants a short POC next week. Main asks: eu-only data residency, BYOK + KMS routing, and an estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted for ~50 req/s. Also they want sub-processor list for an SCC/DPA review. Can we confirm feasibility and rough pricing?

Ben - Solutions: @Devon @Lisa can you confirm region pinning + subproc list? also any blockers for BYOK in EU-only flow? :thinking_face:

Devon - Eng: short answer: feasible. We can pin tenant to EU control plane + compute (eu-west-1 + eu-central-1). Routing: request-level policy can prefer EU endpoints and fall back to a compatible EU replica; if EU capacity saturated we can fail or route to Dedicated hot-standby depending on SLA.

Devon - Eng: sub-processors: primary infra = "MajorCloud" (eu regions), object store = "BlobCo" (eu buckets), monitoring = "MetricsSAAS" (EU data centers). I can paste the current subproc CSV link: https://redwood.internal/docs/subprocs/eu-current (use for legal).

Lisa - Security: For SCC/DPA review you'll need the subproc export + our standard EU addendum. BYOK ok but note: BYOK on Hosted requires shared HSM integration — customer-managed keys (KMS config) supported in Dedicated and Private; Hosted BYOK requires an approved attestation step and can add ~3 business days.

Ana - AE: timeline constraint: they want the POC for next Tue-Wed. Is the 3 day attestation going to block?

Devon - Eng: it depends. For a demo we can do HOSTED with customer-provided keys in a soft-BYOK mode (they upload certs to our key escrow) to show functionality — not full production BYOK. For production-grade BYOK + on-prem key wraps we need Dedicated/Private and the attestation (~3 business days).

Devon - Eng: Routing policy example (config snippet they can use during trial):
```
routing_policy:
  tenant_pin: eu-only
  prefer_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: "reject"  # options: reject / route-dedicated / route-hosted-fallback
```

Ben - Solutions: Pricing ballpark? they asked monthly for a short-term Dedicated POC vs Hosted metered.

Devon - Eng: ballpark numbers (very rough):
- Hosted (eu-only traffic, metered): $0.015 per 1k tokens gen, embeddings separate. For 50 req/s with 8k context, estimate ~ $6k-$12k/month depending on token mix.
- Dedicated (reserved small pool for POC with BYOK and pinning): infra commit roughly $18k-$30k/month depending on GPU class and preemption tolerance. Includes KMS integration on Private/Dedicated.
These are rough; sales should add margin and any integration SOW.

Lisa - Security: Also add compliance time for subproc review — legal wants 5 business days to clear subproc CSV for an enterprise LOA. If they insist on a hard EU-only BCP we may need Private deployment which has longer lead time (~4-6 weeks).

Ana - AE: Noted. Can you also confirm whether we can do tenant pin + BYOK for a Hosted POC with minimal risk? Customer is okay with a demo that doesn't use full BYOK but needs screenable KMS flow.

Devon - Eng: yes — demo path: hosted + mocked BYOK flow (no customer key escrow) or partial BYOK (they upload key material to a temporary escrow for POC). For any production write paths we should recommend Dedicated.

Ben - Solutions: Operational ask — will on-call need extra runbooks? Ops-bot, can you create a stub runbook for tenant pin failover steps? :robot_face:

ops-bot: Created runbook stub: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-pin-failover/5319876543 — includes steps to switch fallback from "reject" to "route-dedicated" and how to toggle KV cache invalidation.

Devon - Eng: one more technical note: prefix/KV caching across regions needs warm-up. If you pin tenant to EU and then flip to Dedicated in a different region, expect initial latency bump until KV cache repopulates. Recommend a short cold-start ramp in the POC script.

Ana - AE: Great. Next actions: 1) Ben to send pricing estimate + SOW draft, 2) Lisa to attach subproc CSV + draft DPA addendum, 3) Devon to prepare demo config + routing snippet and submit infra ticket for EU Dedicated capacity hold. Aim to share by EOD today.

Ben - Solutions: on it. I'll draft email to FinSys legal + procurement with options and costs.

Lisa - Security: attaching subproc link and flagging legal path (I will DM legal for a quick review).

Devon - Eng: opened infra ticket #INF-8821 to reserve a small EU Dedicated pool for Tue/Wed POC. ETA confirmation by EOD.

Ana - AE: thanks all :raised_hands: I'll sync with the customer and send time windows.

Ben - Solutions: FYI — when you share numbers, include note: "estimates subject to token profile and engineering integration; final quote after POC metrics." Keeps expectations aligned.

Ana - AE: will do. closing thread for now, will reopen with updates. :white_check_mark:
